headline: Spot Bitcoin Funds Shed $487 Million as Bitcoin Holds Near 83k and Greed Runs Ahead of the Cash
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost $487 million in the latest print, ether funds lost about $161 million, and solana funds lost $4.8 million, while bitcoin holds near 83k after a 0.6% decline. Fear and greed is already at 69 while the cycle index sits flat at 56 in complacency, so sentiment has leaned in further than the flow reading. Funding is calm at 0.004%, the dollar is firm at 102.57, and volatility is quiet, with the VIX at 15.2 and seven-day realized volatility at 21.3% against 48.9% over thirty days, so the cash leaving the funds is not being chased by leverage or a volatility bid.
author: jordan
